title: Visa TAP failure: replayed nonce
summary: An attacker who captured a signed request resends it inside its window. A verifier that keeps nonces from the last 8 minutes blocks it; a verifier that keeps none accepts it, because the signature is still valid.

steps.label: Original signed request
steps.detail: The agent sends a valid signed request.

payload.content:
GET /example-product HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example
Signature-Input: sig2=("@authority" "@path");created=1767225600;keyid="agent-key-1";alg="Ed25519";expires=1767225900;nonce="bm9uY2UtcGxhY2Vob2xkZXI";tag="agent-browser-auth"
Signature: sig2=:c2lnbmF0dXJlLXBsYWNlaG9sZGVy:

steps.label: Verified and recorded
steps.detail: The CDN verifies it and records the nonce.

steps.label: Same request replayed within 8 minutes
steps.detail: A copy of the same headers arrives again, from the attacker.

payload.content:
GET /example-product HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example
Signature-Input: sig2=("@authority" "@path");created=1767225600;keyid="agent-key-1";alg="Ed25519";expires=1767225900;nonce="bm9uY2UtcGxhY2Vob2xkZXI";tag="agent-browser-auth"
Signature: sig2=:c2lnbmF0dXJlLXBsYWNlaG9sZGVy:

steps.label: Nonce lookup
steps.detail: The nonce is in the record of the last 8 minutes.

failures.outcome: Replay is accepted; TAP makes the record optional
